paragraphs.background: My academic background combines Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence and Data Science. I hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, specializing in Big Data and Data Analytics, and I am currently pursuing an engineering degree in Web and Multimedia Technologies.
paragraphs.interests: I enjoy developing full-stack applications, designing backend services, working with databases and building machine learning solutions. My experience includes web development, deep learning, computer vision, data processing and integrating AI models into practical applications.
paragraphs.motivation: I am motivated by opportunities to solve real-world problems, explore emerging technologies and contribute to innovative software and AI-driven projects.

visiontouch.title: VisionTouch
visiontouch.subtitle: Real-Time Object Detection for Accessibility
visiontouch.description: An AI-powered mobile accessibility solution that uses computer vision to detect objects in real time. The project combines a fine-tuned YOLOv8 model, a Flask inference API, and a Flutter mobile application.
contributions: Prepared and annotated a custom image dataset containing 28 object classes.
Fine-tuned YOLOv8 for real-time object detection.
Developed a Flask REST API to serve model predictions.
Contributed to integrating the computer vision pipeline with the mobile application.

ecg-biometric-identification.title: ECG Biometric Identification
ecg-biometric-identification.subtitle: Biometric Recognition Using ECG Signals
ecg-biometric-identification.description: A biometric identification system based on electrocardiogram signals, combining signal processing, handcrafted feature extraction, machine learning, and deep learning. The project evaluates SVM and 1D-CNN approaches on the ECG-ID dataset.
contributions: Preprocessed ECG signals through filtering, R-peak detection, normalization, and segmentation.
Extracted cepstral coefficients, entropy, and zero-crossing features.
Trained and evaluated SVM and 1D-CNN models.
Integrated the trained model with a Flask API and React interface.

consultdiag.title: ConsultDiag
consultdiag.subtitle: AI-Powered Business Diagnostic Platform
consultdiag.description: A full-stack consultation and business diagnostic platform developed during an internship at NovaSkills. It provides versioned questionnaires, diagnostic scoring, consultation workflows, and AI-assisted analysis using Gemini.
contributions: Developed the Angular frontend and FastAPI backend.
Implemented questionnaire management, response tracking, and scoring.
Integrated Gemini for AI-assisted diagnostic analysis.
Implemented authentication, role-based permissions, PostgreSQL persistence, and file storage.

iot-smart-environment.title: Connected Environmental Monitoring
iot-smart-environment.subtitle: Connected Environmental Monitoring and Prediction
iot-smart-environment.description: An intelligent IoT environmental monitoring system combining ESP32-based sensor acquisition, cloud data storage, backend APIs, and machine learning. The platform collects environmental measurements, integrates weather information, and uses predictive models to estimate rainfall conditions. A Flutter mobile application provides access to monitoring features and notifications.
contributions: Configured ESP32 hardware and environmental sensors for temperature, humidity, rainfall, and air-quality measurements.
Developed backend services for processing sensor readings and integrating external weather data.
Implemented a machine learning pipeline for rainfall prediction using Scikit-learn and hyperparameter optimization with GridSearchCV.
Integrated Supabase and PostgreSQL for environmental data storage and retrieval.

ai-educational-platform.title: AI-Powered Educational Platform
ai-educational-platform.subtitle: Generative AI for Educational Content
ai-educational-platform.description: A full-stack educational platform developed during an internship at MEGA PIXEL. It uses Gemini to process uploaded PDF documents and images and automatically generate educational summaries and quizzes.
contributions: Developed the application using Flask and Angular.
Integrated Gemini API for educational content processing.
Implemented automatic summary and quiz generation.
Developed REST APIs, JWT authentication, and database and file-storage integration.

customer-churn-prediction.title: Customer Churn Prediction
customer-churn-prediction.subtitle: Predictive Analytics Using Machine Learning
customer-churn-prediction.description: An end-to-end machine learning solution designed to identify customers at risk of churn using behavioral and subscription data. The project covers exploratory data analysis, data cleaning, feature engineering, supervised classification, and model evaluation. The predictive functionality is integrated into a web application through a Flask REST API and an Angular frontend.
contributions: Explored customer behavior and subscription attributes to identify potential churn indicators.
Prepared the dataset through data cleaning, preprocessing, and feature engineering.
Trained and compared supervised classification models, including Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and XGBoost.
Evaluated predictive performance and integrated the machine learning workflow into a Flask-based API.
Connected the prediction service to an Angular frontend for interactive use.

edusmart.title: EduSmart
edusmart.subtitle: Smart Learning Platform with Android & Flask
edusmart.description: EduSmart is a smart learning platform combining a native Android application with a Flask REST API. It enables users to create and organize courses and chapters, automatically generate educational summaries and quizzes, track learning progress, and share educational content. The platform features JWT-based authentication, role-based access control, and PostgreSQL-backed data management.
contributions: Developed a smart learning platform connecting an Android mobile application to a Flask REST API.
Implemented course and chapter management with structured educational content.
Integrated automatic summary and quiz generation for personalized learning and self-assessment.
Implemented user authentication and role-based access control using JWT.
Integrated PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy, and Supabase storage into the backend architecture.
Connected the Android application to backend services using Retrofit.
